subject: English
passage: Despite the availability of sophisticated digital audio workstations, many musicians still choose to record their initial song demos using analog equipment and only later transfer them to digital formats for final production. It may be tempting to speculate about how a song recorded this way would be affected if it had been created entirely with digital tools instead, but each musical work is a unique creation emerging from a specific combination of factors. Therefore, ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: to improve their sound quality, musicians who currently record their demos with analog equipment should instead work exclusively with digital tools.
choices.B: musicians who do most of their initial recording with analog equipment likely produce more commercially successful songs than those who work entirely with digital tools.
choices.C: there is no way to reasonably determine how a musical work would be different if it had been created using alternative methods.
choices.D: songs recorded with analog equipment require more time to complete, on average, than songs recorded with digital tools do.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer because it presents the conclusion that most logically follows from the text's discussion of the methods musicians use to record their songs. After stating that many musicians still choose to record demos with analog equipment even though digital tools are now widely available, the text acknowledges the speculation that the opposite choice—using only digital tools—would have had an effect on such songs. However, the text then points out that every musical work is the unique result of a combination of the particular factors surrounding its creation. This suggests that it isn't possible to determine the effect of any single factor (such as the recording method) on its own; thus, there would be no way to reasonably determine how a song would have turned out differently if it had been created using alternative methods.

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the text doesn't suggest that it produces better sound quality to record a song with digital tools than to record it with analog equipment; it doesn't address sound quality at all. Therefore, it isn't logical to conclude that musicians who currently choose to record demos with analog equipment should instead work exclusively with digital tools to improve their sound quality.
